response.original_title: Forging Military Spacepower: AFSC Staff Film Report #120
response.overview: US Air Force Systems Command staff film report for June 1964, issued under the AFSC's standing banner "Forging Military Spacepower". Six unclassified segments on aerospace research and development: the NF-104A Aerospace Trainer (Air Force Flight Test Center, Col. C. E. Yeager); the J-5 High Altitude Test Cell (Arnold Engineering Test Center); the X-15A-2 (Aeronautical Systems Division); Aircraft/Tower Gust Measurement (Research and Technology Division); F-111 Components (Aeronautical Systems Division); and Low Temperature Evaluation of the CH-47A and F-4C (Aeronautical Systems Division). Produced by Military Air Transport Service, Air Photographic and Charting Service, FR-434, 1350th Motion Picture Squadron, 1964. A work of the US federal government, and therefore public domain. Distinct from NARA record 342-FR-309, a separate 1962 film also titled Forging Military Space Power.
